## What is Grammars Gone Mental?

Grammars Gone Mental (GGM) is a group blog about language, linguistics and cognitive science. It was started by Brian Dillon, Tim Hunter, Dave Kush, Ellen Lau, Laurel Perkins, Matt Wagers, and Ming Xiang. You can read about our motivations [here](posts/2026-11-ggm-origin-story/index.qmd).

We're interested in many kinds of posts:

- **Reactions** to specific papers, debates and claims
- **Bite-sized tutorials** on methods, models and formal tools
- **Round-ups** of recent research
- **Conjectures and kvetches** about what we think the field is missing

We give each other feedback before anything goes up, and every post is written by its human authors. We aim to publish about once a week.

## Contributing

## Citation, permanence

Every post ends with a ready-made citation in APA style and BibTeX, with a
button to copy either. Example:

Lastname, F. (2026, Month D). Post title. *Grammars Gone Mental*.
`https://ggmblog.org/posts/<slug>/`

Posts are version-controlled in a Git repository. Each post should have its own perma-url.
